body:
Connor O'Brien: trying to lock rollout window for provision-to-ready (staged) + align w release train. target is us-east / A100 only. can we do Tue 10:00–14:00 PT or do we need to wait for Wed train?

Harish Reddy: Tue works for fleet ops, but we need a clear rollback owner + who’s on the hook if capacity dips.

Sahana Iyer: image pipeline has a candidate bake finishing tonight. if we roll Tue, we can promote candidate->stable Mon EOD if validations look clean.

Vanessa Ortiz: +1 Tue. would prefer *not* to wait for Wed train bc we’re sitting on manual steps. but we need to respect change freeze for other stuff.

Ethan Park: control plane readiness state changes are behind flag, but the DB migration is already live. for release train: code shipped already, this is flag enable + terraform var enable.

Connor O'Brien: ok, sounds like flag enable is the “release moment” then. Wed train isn’t strictly required, but we should treat it like a release w comms + oncall coverage.

ReleaseBot: Reminder: Weekly release train deploy window is Wed 12:00–16:00 PT. Change freeze begins 30m prior.

Rafael Mendes: from SRE side, Tues is fine if we set alerting to ticket-only for first 2h and have a paging owner if time-to-ready blows up.

Aisha Bello: current alert rules can page on P95 time-to-ready + validation failure rate, but I’d rather we keep paging disabled until we confirm cardinality is safe. we can do “notify-only” in #eng-sre.

Connor O'Brien: proposing:
- Rollout window: Tue 10:30–13:30 PT
- Scope: us-east + A100 dedicated pools only
- Rollout mechanism: enable feature flag + terraform rollout var
- Rollback: kill switch flag off + revert terraform var (and if needed pin image channel to last stable)

Connor O'Brien: checklist draft (pls add gaps):
1) ✅ PRs merged + tags cut: readiness gate, validation agent, metrics
2) ✅ Feature flag exists + default OFF (region/pool scoped)
3) ✅ Terraform vars constrained to us-east/A100 only (plan reviewed)
4) ✅ Golden image channel pinned (stable) + candidate available for fallback
5) ✅ Dashboards live: step breakdown + failure heatmap + quarantine count
6) ✅ SLO baselines captured (P50/P95) + expected improvement target
7) ✅ Oncall coverage: Infra + Platform + SRE in thread + handoff notes
8) ✅ Comms: #eng-infra, #eng-sre, #eng-platform + status page internal note
9) ✅ Rollback owner identified + explicit triggers
10) ✅ Post-rollout validation: 10 node sample + canary inference smoke pass

Harish Reddy: rollback triggers should include: quarantine count spikes > X, or any pool goes below min healthy capacity for >15m.

Vanessa Ortiz: add “stop condition: validation failure rate > 5% for 30m” (or similar). also: confirm kubelet join isn’t blocked by new RBAC.

Ethan Park: for rollback, platform can own “flag off” and “gate disable” if we need to let nodes join serving pool. but that’s riskier.

Rafael Mendes: can we explicitly say we won’t bypass gate unless Priya/Sean approve? otherwise we’ll get tempted when capacity tight.

Connor O'Brien: yep. rollback plan will be:
- Step 1: disable rollout flag (no new nodes enter pipeline)
- Step 2: quarantine/reimage stuck nodes per runbook
- Step 3: if capacity emergency, only then consider bypass gate w exec approval

Sahana Iyer: for image pinning: stable is `gpu-worker-2025.02.10.1`. candidate is `gpu-worker-2025.02.11.0`. if anything weird, we can pin back to .10.1 in terraform.

Aisha Bello: dashboards link for Tue (WIP but usable): https://grafana.redwood.example/d/provision-to-ready/overview

Harish Reddy: who’s rollback owner though? needs to be a single name for “make the call”.

Connor O'Brien: propose rollback owner = Vanessa (fleet). platform owner for control plane = Ethan. SRE escalation = Rafael. I’ll run comms + change log.

Vanessa Ortiz: ok I can be rollback owner for the staged window. if I’m heads-down, Harish can be backup.

Harish Reddy: ack.

Ethan Park: works.

Rafael Mendes: works, just make sure paging rotation knows. and please add a 30-min checkpoint during rollout to decide continue/stop.

Connor O'Brien: added checkpoint 11:30 PT + 12:30 PT. I’ll send calendar + a short go/no-go doc.

Connor O'Brien: action items before Tue:
- Sahana: confirm candidate->stable promotion decision by Mon 16:00 PT
- Aisha: set alerts to notify-only + confirm tag cardinality
- Ethan: validate flag scoping + audit log for flag toggles
- Vanessa/Harish: pre-provision 5 nodes to test end-to-end in us-east A100

Sahana Iyer: :thumbsup:

Aisha Bello: :thumbsup: will post alert config diff in thread.

Ethan Park: :thumbsup:

Vanessa Ortiz: :thumbsup:

Connor O'Brien: cool. will post final checklist + owners in a pinned message once I clean it up.
